summary: The candidate fixes the ordinary Qwen3.5/Qwen3-VL terminal-position IndexError and its focused regression passes, but it leaves the original issue's Qwen2/Qwen3 silent-drop variants unchanged and fails on Qwen3.5's deferred FlashInfer finalization branch because capture occurs before the handoff is finalized.

tests.command: python -c '<construct 32-layer Qwen3_5ForCausalLM and set shifted positions [4,12,20,28,32]>' on recorded base
tests.what_was_measured: Exact original setup failure: IndexError at self.layers[32].

tests.command: python adversarial fixture invoking real Qwen2Model.forward and inherited Qwen3Model.forward with terminal capture position
tests.what_was_measured: Both models silently returned no auxiliary capture for position num_layers.

tests.command: python adversarial fixture passing Qwen35MoeFinalizeHandoff to candidate terminal capture helper
tests.what_was_measured: Candidate raises TypeError before the existing deferred finalization logic.
Candidate helper output on gfx950 exactly equaled an independently computed CPU hidden+residual reference.
Candidate's claimed diff check does not pass due to trailing whitespace in a retained log.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 ran the candidate terminal residual-stream arithmetic and exactly matched the CPU reference.

remaining_counterexamples: Qwen2Model and Qwen3Model still silently omit a requested terminal capture position equal to num_layers.
Qwen3.5 FlashInfer MNNVL deferred finalization supplies Qwen35MoeFinalizeHandoff at the candidate's new capture point, causing TypeError when residual is added before finalize.
Repeated Qwen3.5 capture configuration leaves stale _is_layer_to_capture flags on formerly selected layers.
remaining_limitations: Qwen3.5-4B weights were unavailable, so no full model/server startup was run.
Ascend NPU hardware was unavailable; the assigned architecture was AMD gfx950.
The GPU run validates boundary arithmetic only, not model semantics or distributed execution.
No native rebuild was needed because the candidate changes only Python and report/test files.
